x64p9mkj.variantName: Walplus 907 Branch Tips Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
x64p9mkj.sourceDescription: This beautiful artificial hinged Christmas tree is very lifelike in its shape and appearance and is meant to create just the right atmosphere for this Christmas. Hinged construction: The Christmas tree has a hinged construction, so the branches will automatically fold down at the right angle. This will make it much easier to put up the tree in the perfect shape and will save you time as well.Lifelike PE tips: The Christmas decoration has realistic PE tips, made by injection moulding, giving the tree a more natural appearance.Sturdy stand: The metal stand provides your artificial Christmas tree with optimal sturdiness and stability.Flocked snow design: The Xmas tree has artificial white snow on it, giving an attractive snow-flocked look.Economical choice: You can reuse the Christmas ornament every year, which is a cost-effective option compared to getting a real tree. Good to know:We recommend setting aside 45-60 minutes after assembly to properly shape the tree by peeling back the branches and pulling the tips apart to give the branches a more full-bodied look. Product Specifications Colour: Green and white PVC (polyvinylchloride), PE (polyethylene), metal Total height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 137 cm Stand size: 60 x 18 cm (W x H) Hinged construction With 907 PVC tips and 205 PE tips Decorated with flocked snow Suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Artificial hinged Christmas tree 1 x Stand • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

pekky65c.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Woodland Pine Hinged Branches Tree
pekky65c.sourceDescription: One of our most realistic Christmas trees, the Woodland Pine has a "freshly cut" look. A bushy Christmas tree boasting dark green foliage and a mix of PE & PVC branch tips, the Woodland Pine has a charming realism to it that few artificial Christmas trees achieve. What's more, this 6ft pre-lit Christmas tree comes with LEDs already attached to the branches that's right, no more untangling Christmas lights! The tips are expertly moulded from real tree needles to create a greater degree of realism. You'll also find strong hinged branches on the Woodland Pine, making the tree easy to put up and bring down. Picture shows 7ft tree in the range.
